original_card.question: Does a new paid-profile or mixture-ceiling claim have independent source-bound coverage of its actual changed ledger?
methods: Independently reconstruct one changed paid ledger or pooled dual with exact source and model binding.
Check a genuinely uncovered moment implication with a different enclosure method and semantic controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Choose one uncovered implication in #4088 literal mixed fill, #4091 pooled dual/model binding or #4067 changed frame/host bill. #4091 pins an earlier #4088 head: validate word, capacity and stock equivalence before applying that ceiling to the later fill.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently reconstruct one changed ledger or pooled certificate with a positive case and a semantic failure control. Compare exact sources and name what existing checks miss. Keep this separate from supplier-boundary-audit (ordinary/outer dispatch) and uniform-transfer-audit (all-size proof). Stop after the chosen implication; more digits of an unchanged root are not additional mechanism coverage.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Calling an aggregate histogram or source archive an independently accepted physical supplier.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4088: mixed local/owner/phase ledger and moment reported.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent binding of changed construction to paid histogram, distinct from full admission.

existing_checks.remaining: Validate dual, exhaustive pattern scope and exact source equivalence before applying to newer fills.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4067: paid (2,2) to (1,3) exchange and fixed OQ4 host reported.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent full cost delta; remaining caller/precision/stock obligations are separate.

actual_scope: Independent source-bound join of the selected #4470 p16 complete invoice: CONTROLLER.json event word and diagonal plus the #4504 per-orientation local unit, bound to RESULT.json, NATIVE.json.gz, the embedded controller invoice and #4478's hard-coded histogram; second-method (decimal, directed rounding) enclosure of the raw surplus at the selected kappa and tested saving, the root bracket and the three completion tails.
scope_change_reason: The card's starting examples (#4088/#4091/#4067) predate the selected record. The selected change is #4470. Its local unit (#4504), controller Laurent word (pr4470-controller-replay) and arithmetic on a hard-coded histogram (#4478) are independently covered; no non-author code joined the two derived parts into the histogram that #4478 evaluates.
bottleneck_link: Independent pricing of the selected record: the raw surplus at kappa is below one rank-one job, so the frontier depends on the complete histogram being exact at single-job resolution.
stop_rule: Stop at the complete p16 histogram and its moment/tail inequalities at kappa and the tested saving. No native, Laurent, compiler or outer-theorem replay.
evidence: verify.py prints PASS_PR4470_INVOICE_JOIN: 18 full calls (2 forward, 16 backward), 15 query shears; 10,928 fields, 64,620 jobs, masses 239,886/239,134 agree across the event-word join, the #4440 closed form, RESULT.json, NATIVE.json.gz, the embedded controller invoice and #4478's literals. Raw surplus lower bounds 0.0039520 at kappa and 0.0027152 at tested; alpha < 0.999999988558809, gamma < 0.956176646498, delta < 0.958284435310. 15 controls reject; 8 of 8 verifier mutants fail.

open_questions.question: Is every rank-one paid job of the p16 invoice physically present, with no uncharged operation omitted, at single-job resolution?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The raw surplus at kappa is 0.00395 of one rank-one job and the alpha headroom is about 1e-8 against about 4e-6 per job: one missing charge anywhere (copy, query, owned-stream erase, center) would invalidate the selected kappa.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate the per-port operations of one thin query shear and one IDLE window from the #4440 owned-stream protocol and match each to a charged histogram entry or an explicit nonrecursive allowance.
open_questions.blocked_by: Requires the physical query/owned-stream contract, an inherited premise outside this ledger join.

open_questions.question: Is the uniform per-call unit correct for the stage-zero full call, whose multiplier is the nine-axis F9 Q^-1 rather than a fresh eight-axis D_s?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This join charges the same #4504 unit at all 18 thick stages, following #4440/#4470; a stage-zero-specific unit would change the histogram.
open_questions.first_step: Locate the stage-zero native call in the #4470 word and compare its frame audit with the generic unit.
open_questions.blocked_by: None; the stage-zero commutation audits cover operators, not the per-call bill.
